title: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

STATE BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
STATE BANK OF
PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CX OF 2002
(An Ordinance
further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956)
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary Part I, 4th November, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
4-11-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the State Bank of Pakistan
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: State Bank of Pakistan Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 9B, Act XXXIII of 1956

STATE BANK OF PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
STATE BANK OF
PAKISTAN (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CX OF 2002
(An Ordinance
further to amend the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956)
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary Part I, 4th November, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
4-11-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 9B,
Act XXXIII of 1956.---In the State Bank of Pakistan Act, 1956 (XXXIII of
1956), thereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 9B, after
subsection (5), the following new subsection shall be added, namely:---
"(6) In
carrying out its assigned functions of coordinating fiscal, monetary and
exchange rate policies and for ensuring constituency among macro economic,
targets of growth, inflation and fiscal, monetary and external accounts as laid
down in subsections (1), (2), (3), (4) and (5), the Coordination Board shall
not take any treasure that would adversely affect the autonomy of the State
Bank of Pakistan as provided in this Act.

3. Amendment of section 10,
Act XXXIII of 1956.---In the said Act, in section 10, for subsection (3),
the following shall be substituted, namely:---
"(3) Subject
to subsection (11), the Governor shall be appointed by the President for a term
of three years and on such salary and terms and conditions of service as the
President may determine, except that neither the salary of the Governor nor his
other terms and conditions of service shall be varied to his disadvantage after
his appointment:
Provided that the Governor shall
be eligible for re-appointment for another term of three years:
Provided further that no person
shall hold the office of the Governor after attaining the age of sixty-five
years."

5. Substitution of section 22,
Act XXXIII of 1956.---In the said Act for section 22 the following shall be
substituted, namely:---
"22. Service
charges.---(1) The Bank shall make public from time to time the standard
service charges at which it is prepared to provide financial accommodation to
the borrowing entities.
(2) In respect of finance
provided by the Bank it may determine, from time to time, the terms and
conditions either generally or specially."
